_comment: Differences between a live database and a clean build of the migrations that were reviewed and kept on purpose (see the 0060 and 0061 headers). The rehearsal runs with --strict: anything NOT listed here fails it. Keys are 'kind|object' (objects cut at 63 characters).

liveOnly.function|rls_auto_enable(): Supabase's own event-trigger helper that enables RLS on new tables (event trigger ensure_rls); keep
liveOnly.func_exec|rls_auto_enable(): execute rights of the platform helper above
liveOnly.policy|community_reports.reports insert: backs the app's admin demo-seeding feature (admin-only INSERT)
liveOnly.policy|report_tracking.tracking update: same demo-seeding feature (reviewer UPDATE of tracking rows)
liveOnly.policy|meta.meta select public: meta holds one key, public_stats (aggregated public statistics only)
liveOnly.column|community_reports.rate_bucket: unused legacy column, harmless; dropping it destroys data for no benefit
liveOnly.constraint|community_reports.community_r: legacy input rule (minimum 10 characters), stricter than the repo's; changing it changes what users can submit
